question: Rukmini Devi Arundale, awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1957, was a _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Rukmini Devi Arundale**

__
 
• **Indian theosophist, dancer and choreographer of the Indian classical dance form of Bharatanatyam**
 
• Also an** activist for animal welfare.**
 
• She was the** first woman in Indian history to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha (**the upper house of the Parliament of India).
 
• She features in **India Today's list of '100 People Who Shaped India'**.
 
• Awarded by** Padma Bhushan in 1956** and the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award ****in 1957.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Bharatnatyam**

 
• **Bala Saraswati** is regarded as the **queen of Bharatnatyam.**
 
• **oldest and most popular** forms of classical dance that originated in **Tanjore district in Tamil Nadu in South India**.
 
• The **origin** of this form can be traced to the **sage Bharata Muni's Natyasastra.**
 
• **Sadir, Chinnamelan and Dasi Attam or Daasiyattam** are the original names.
